nodes.label: React Component JSDoc Convention
nodes.rationale: Component documentation must live as a JSDoc/TSDoc block directly in the .tsx file, never as separate markdown (no docs/components/, no per-component .md, no index). Rationale: keeps docs co-located with the prop signature so a signature change forces a doc update in the same pass; fixed block order (summary, @remarks with Status/Type/State/Variants/Composition/Accessibility/Test ids/CSS classes/Edge cases/Dependencies, @example, @see) keeps docs scannable across the codebase; prose // comments are banned in favor of JSDoc so caveats stay attached to the exported symbol.

nodes.label: Graphify Knowledge-Graph Usage Rules
nodes.rationale: The project maintains a knowledge graph at graphify-out/ with god nodes, community structure and cross-file relationships. Agents must read GRAPH_REPORT.md before reading source, grepping, or answering codebase questions, navigate wiki/index.md if present, prefer graphify query/path/explain over grep for cross-module questions, and run graphify update after edits — rationale is that the graph is cheaper and more structurally aware than re-scanning files, and AST-only updates avoid API cost.

nodes.label: Chrome MCP Usage Gate
nodes.rationale: "Don't use chrome mcp use it when i say so" — the user reserves explicit control over when the chrome-devtools MCP tools are invoked, rather than letting the agent decide autonomously.
